data.title: 芙兰达 · 废弃核掩体的胶带炸弹连环暴烈
data.description: 学园都市地下废弃避难所回廊内，红色警报旋转嘶鸣。芙兰达双手各夹着数卷炸药胶带与引爆器凌空后翻，嘴角勾起“结果全搞定~”的标志性狡黠狞笑，身后火光冲天。
data.location: dim industrial bunker blast corridor lit by flashing red emergency sirens and smoke
data.action: leaping backward in dynamic midair combat dodge, slinging explosive tape rolls from fingertips, triumphant fanged smirk against detonation blast
data.lighting: 背后剧烈爆炸的赤红烈焰与警报红光
data.promptProse: Frenda leaps backward through an industrial blast corridor flinging rolls of explosive tape with a triumphant, fanged smirk as explosions erupt behind her.
data.animaCaption: Fiery blast light illuminates her beret and flying blonde hair as the tape bombs detonate.
